patches.change: inject a non-deferred <script src="wasm-inline.js"> immediately before the deferred net.js script
patches.reason: runs the inlined-wasm shim during parse, before net.js, so the byte global exists before net.js initialises

patches.change: generated: base64-inlines net.wasm (sha256 3195eba328b17eab5d71de3c0c9783139b1083ea67c6e7c88e08f1a8c0e04892) into the plain global window.__NET_WASM_BYTES__; net.wasm itself is not shipped
patches.reason: a plain global (not Module.wasmBinary, which net.js reassigns at startup) carries the bytes so no runtime wasm fetch happens; the sha256 ties the inlined bytes back to upstream net.wasm

patches.change: one line after the Module['wasmBinary'] read: seed the local wasmBinary from window.__NET_WASM_BYTES__ when present
patches.reason: makes the emscripten loader use the inlined bytes so it never fetches net.wasm — required under the opaque-origin sandbox (allow-scripts, no allow-same-origin), where a null-origin fetch of net.wasm is CORS-blocked on static hosting
